description: INT0 on PB2 counts only rising edges, the pin-change interrupt on PB3 counts every change; both share GIMSK and GIFR on the ATtiny85.
basis: ATtiny85 datasheet 9.2 and 9.3: INT0 with ISC01:0 = 11 fires on rising edges, PCINT fires on every change of an enabled pin (PCMSK, PCIE in GIMSK); the case drives PB2 low-high three times and PB3 high-low twice: 3 rising edges, 4 changes
